How to say one thing is *bigger / smaller / smarter* than another. Egyptian has a tidy pattern for it, and one feature that makes it easier than the adjectives you already know. Tap any example to reveal its franco and English.

## The pattern

Take an adjective, reshape it into the **أفعل (af3al)** mould, and follow it with **من (men)** "than":

**[subject] + [أفعل form] + من + [the thing compared]**

*ana **atwal men** a5uya* — "I'm **taller than** my brother".

## The forms

| Adjective - franco | Comparative - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| طويل - tawil | أطول - atwal | taller |
| قصير - 2osayyar | أقصر - a2sar | shorter |
| كبير - kbeer | أكبر - akbar | bigger / older |
| صغير - so8ayyar | أصغر - as8ar | smaller / younger |
| ذكي - zaki | أذكى - azka | smarter |
| حلو - 7elw | أحلى - a7la | nicer / prettier |
| كتير - ketir | أكتر - aktar | more |
| قليل - 2alil | أقل - a2all | less / fewer |

## The easy part: it doesn't agree

Ordinary adjectives change for gender — *tawil* (m.) becomes *tawila* (f.). The **comparative does not**. The أفعل form is **invariable**: it's *atwal* whether you're talking about a man, a woman, or a crowd.

- *huwwa atwal* — he's taller
- *hiyya atwal* — she's taller (same word)

## Examples

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا أطول من أخويا</summary>
<span class="fr">ana atwal men a5uya</span>
<span class="en">I'm taller than my brother</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>هي أذكى من أختها</summary>
<span class="fr">hiyya azka men o5taha</span>
<span class="en">she's smarter than her sister</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>القاهرة أكبر من الإسكندرية</summary>
<span class="fr">el-Qahira akbar men el-Eskendereyya</span>
<span class="en">Cairo is bigger than Alexandria</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>ابني أصغر من بنتي</summary>
<span class="fr">ibni as8ar men binti</span>
<span class="en">my son is younger than my daughter</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>عايز أقل سكر</summary>
<span class="fr">3ayez a2all sukkar</span>
<span class="en">I want less sugar</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>محتاج أكتر وقت</summary>
<span class="fr">me7tag aktar wa2t</span>
<span class="en">I need more time</span>
</details>

### Exercise 3 — Does it change?

Give "taller" for each — and notice the answer.

**1.** he is taller

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>

<span class="fr">huwwa atwal</span>
</details>

**2.** she is taller

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>

<span class="fr">hiyya atwal (same form — comparatives don't agree)</span>
